method: Engineering estimate, equal-weight feature-family rubric. NOT measured code coverage or a qualified percent. Scores from review of PS0 source, old RC4 experiment evidence, and candidate fixtures. Exact PS0 stable CI absent. A 5 requires 100% normative acceptance in that family; 4 requires near-complete tested coverage. Current scores capped at 3 until PS0 stable CI is verified.

rubric.0: No implementation for required selected family (even if explicit refusal exists)
rubric.1: Foundation/allowlist or small partial helper only
rubric.2: Meaningful syntax/semantic subset, but major normative coverage absent
rubric.3: Coherent selected subset with native Lean semantic lowering and historical/candidate source examples; stable PS0 qualification absent
rubric.4: Broad feature coverage with exact-commit CI and remaining narrow gaps
rubric.5: Full normative selected family, positive/negative semantic conformance and exact-commit CI qualified

scope: 20 equally weighted v7 language-semantic families including libraries, import semantics, and mandatory source assurance; excludes native backend optimization, IDE polish and standalone packaging.
qualification: Engineering readiness estimate 40% (class/instance source family 2→3/5). Full stable Lean CI and all 181 normative qualification IDs still lack PASS evidence. No score credit from unrestricted .lean.

families.name: Lexing, trivia, Unicode and brace ownership
families.rationale: Selected Lean scanner and grammar checks; exhaustive v7 lexical/source-category closure missing

families.name: Definitions, functions, const, theorem and modifiers
families.rationale: Several source heads and nullary lowering implemented; modifier, recursive and proof forms incomplete

families.name: Explicit, implicit, instance and dependent binder telescopes
families.rationale: PS0 now models ordered explicit comma-groups interleaved with implicit, strict-implicit and anonymous/named typeclass binders in native Lean declarations; native fallback def/theorem adjacency is also checked. Exact stable CI and full v7 grammar closure remain missing.

families.name: Adjacent, named, default, partial and empty calls
families.rationale: Custom call syntax and type-directed Unit handling; mixed call/metamorphic closure not complete

families.name: Namespaces, sections, variables and visibility
families.rationale: Lean namespace/section support selected; full generalization and public export policy unqualified

families.name: PS modules, imports and re-exports
families.rationale: PS project headers and public imports correctly fail closed; real graph and v7 visibility not implemented

families.name: Universes, Prop, Pi, quantifiers, subtypes and coercions
families.rationale: Native Lean semantic engine present; selected grammar/typed differential closure incomplete

families.name: Numerics, fixed widths, strings, literals and collections
families.rationale: Lean types and selected literals accessible; full API/Float/word/UTF-8 profile unverified

families.name: If, dependent if, if let and matches
families.rationale: Braced if and if-let lowered through Lean; matches has new candidate tests; full typed/negative matrix pending

families.name: Nominal structures, records, constructors and updates
families.rationale: Braced structure macros exist; dependent fields/update/constructor grammar not closed

families.name: Classes, instances, priorities and deriving
families.rationale: PS0 now owns class structure and selected braced named/anonymous instance sources, enforces real record-initializer fields before macros run, refuses native Lean instance value/unbraced forms in .ps, and lowers to official Lean class/instance elaboration. Full v7 instance binder telescopes, priority names/numeric priorities, handler manifest and exact stable CI remain unfinished.

families.name: Inductives, matches, motives, patterns and nomatch
families.rationale: Braced inductive/match macros and native Lean elimination; complete dependent-pattern closure missing

families.name: Structural, mutual, local where and well-founded recursion
families.rationale: PS0 now lowers selected source termination_by measure and braced decreasing_by by {tactics} to official Lean 4.35 total/well-founded recursion, while rejecting Lean-only modes and bare decrease hints in .ps. Structural/mutual/local recursion remains partial; no stable CI acceptance yet.

families.name: Theorems, proof tactics and source diagnostic commands
families.rationale: Native Lean kernel/tactics and selected proof grammar with historical fixtures; complete tactic allowlist and positions missing

families.name: Do, mutable state, loops, invariants, erased/assert
families.rationale: Typed native Lean do with existing verified loop guards; full v7 do category and verification closure incomplete

families.name: Given, requires, ensures, spec and VC generation
families.rationale: Macros delegate to native Lean contract/Std.WP; complete spec attachments and transitive VC coverage missing

families.name: Reader, State, Except, typed errors, FFI/IO capabilities
families.rationale: Sound Lean-native WP relation samples exist; approved world effects/typed P1 capabilities far from complete

families.name: P0 List/Array/String and P1 map/set/JSON APIs
families.rationale: Small allowlisted native modules exist; complete APIs and typed codec/foreign boundaries missing

families.name: Canonical environment, tactics, instances and semantic manifest
families.rationale: Provisional import/deriving/scalar roster only; full deterministic environment registry missing

families.name: Assumptions, erasure, proof obligation and verified profile
families.rationale: Selected local check and approved axiom list exist; imported full verification/erasure closure missing
